spoken_summary: At a speaking event, JD Vance calls on a young boy from the audience. The boy, who introduces himself as Henry, tells Vance, "I skipped school today, I was wondering if I could get a picture with you." The audience laughs and applauds. Vance agrees, joking, "I guess you gotta have some excuse to skip school," and brings Henry on stage for a photo.
